donor.front_order: exact manifest emission order; 8 structured fronts followed by 8 deterministic source-hash exploration fronts

ecology_policy.if_canonical_status_is_SAT_or_UNSAT: return canonical immediately; zero Slime donor generation or challenger execution
if_canonical_status_is_OPEN: generate the pinned v3 16-front manifest once from the root CNF
for each front in manifest emission order, filter linear_leaf_order to v:<integer> root pivot priority
run the unchanged pinned C025 exact solver under that proposal-only priority
if result is OPEN continue to next front
if result is SAT or UNSAT rerun the identical front from the original CNF
only matching exact replay may stop the swarm and return the decisive candidate result

work_accounting.canonical_exact_paid_work: paid_work of the baseline C1/K0 call
work_accounting.challenger_exact_paid_work: sum paid_work of every logically executed challenger first pass; replay work is verification overhead and is reported separately
work_accounting.replay_verification_work: sum paid_work of matching decisive replay calls
work_accounting.slime_generation_ops: pinned v3 total_generation_ops, charged once only on canonical OPEN formulas
work_accounting.pivot_projection_ops: sum len(linear_leaf_order) over all 16 candidates, charged once only on canonical OPEN formulas

algorithm: Start with connectivity backbone i=1..8 on supports [i,i+1,i+2] with independent rng.getrandbits(1) signs.
Sample three distinct variables uniformly from 1..10 with independent signs until 42 unique canonical non-tautological width-3 clauses exist.
Canonical literal order is (abs(literal), literal<0); preserve formula insertion order.
No R1/R2 result, SAT result, Slime score, or prior holdout output participates in generation.
